assistant.title: Strategy helper
assistant.intro: Tell the helper about yourself once, in your own words, and it can start from there when it helps you set up or revise a strategy.

notes.title: My investing background
notes.helpTitle: What is this, and who reads it?
notes.help1: These notes are what the strategy helper knows about you: your goals, how long you invest for, how you feel about risk, rules you want to keep and what you decided in earlier talks. Write them yourself, or let Claude write a profile from the chats you already had with it and paste that in.
notes.help2: They are stored only in Folio (and in its backups). Nothing else in Folio reads them, and they leave the app only inside a helper session that you start with your own API key. Leave out account numbers, names of other people and exact amounts.
notes.none: No notes yet. Add one below; the helper works without notes too, it just asks more questions.
notes.budget: The helper reads {{used}} of at most {{limit}} characters of your notes, newest first.
notes.leftOut: {{n}} switched-on note(s) do not fit under that limit and are left out. Switch some off or shorten them.
notes.writeHint: A few sentences are plenty: what the money is for, when you may need it, how a big fall would feel, rules you want to keep.
notes.claudeStep1: Copy the text below and paste it into a chat with Claude (claude.ai), ideally one where you talked about your investing before. This uses your Claude subscription, not the API.
notes.claudeStep2: Read what Claude writes and correct it in the chat. Remove anything private.
notes.claudeStep3: Paste the final text in the box under it and save it as a note.

paste.title: Use my Claude subscription (free)
paste.intro: Folio gives you one prompt. Paste it into a new chat on claude.ai, talk it through there, and paste Claude's finished strategy back here. Folio checks it and shows you what it means before you save anything. Nothing is sent from Folio; this runs on your own Claude subscription.
paste.what: What do you want help with?
paste.includes: The prompt holds the rules for the interview, the format of a strategy, your holdings as shares of the portfolio (no euro amounts) and {{n}} characters of your background notes.
paste.step2: Talk it through with Claude. When it gives you the strategy, copy its whole answer.
paste.answer: Claude's answer (the whole reply is fine)
paste.problems: Folio found problems in this strategy. Copy them back to Claude so it can fix the document.

proposal.title: What this strategy does
proposal.diffTitle: What changes against the current version
proposal.noChange: Nothing changes against the current version.
proposal.saveNew: Save as a new strategy (switched off)
proposal.saveVersion: Save as a new version of {{name}}
proposal.activeWarn: {{name}} is active, so a new version starts working at once. You can go back to an earlier version in its History.
proposal.offNote: A new strategy is saved switched off. Nothing changes until you switch it on.

describe.name: Name: {{name}}.
describe.sleeve: {{name}}: target {{target}}% of the portfolio, {{n}} holding(s) listed.
describe.bands: {{name}}: early warning at {{soft}} points off target, firm warning at {{hard}}.
describe.trim: {{name}}: warn above {{trim}}% (time to think about taking profit).
describe.company: One company may be at most {{pct}}% of the portfolio across all funds.

rule.drift_band: Warn when a group drifts outside its band.
rule.trim_threshold: Warn when a group grows above its trim level.
rule.concentration_limit: Warn when one company (or country) is too large across all funds.
rule.drawdown_position: Warn when a holding is down {{threshold}}% from its peak.
rule.drawdown_portfolio: Warn when the portfolio is down {{threshold}}% from its peak.
rule.price_move: Warn about a large price move in a holding.
rule.price_level: Warn when a holding crosses a set price.
rule.macro_threshold: Watch {{series}} and warn when it passes its level or moves.
rule.correlation_shift: Warn when the hedge stops moving against what it protects.
rule.contribution_due: Remind {{days}} day(s) before the regular contribution.
rule.cash_buffer: Warn when cash is outside the wanted range.
rule.thesis_review_due: Remind when a written view is due for review.

import.step1: On claude.ai open Settings, Privacy, and choose Export data. Claude emails you a link; download the zip.
import.step2: Choose that zip (or the conversations.json inside it) below. Folio reads it on the server and does not keep it. Pick up to 8 chats that are about your investing.
import.step3: Folio shows what it can cost, then has the cheapest Claude model write a short summary of each chat. You read and edit them, and keep the ones you want as notes.
import.found: {{total}} chats found; {{relevant}} look like talks about investing.
import.cost: Summarising can cost up to {{cost}}. This month you have {{left}} left of your AI budget.
import.privacy: This sends the text of the chosen chats to Anthropic's API with your own key. Nothing is sent before you press the button below.
import.noFit: That does not fit what is left of this month's AI budget. Choose fewer chats, raise the budget in Settings, Agent, or use the free way: ask Claude to write the profile.
import.working: Summarising, one chat at a time. This takes a few seconds per chat…
import.review: Read each summary and correct it. Keep only what is true and what you want the helper to know.
import.nothing: Nothing about your own investing in this chat.
import.spent: This cost {{cost}} of your AI budget.
import.saved: Saved {{n}} note(s). You can find them above.

assistant.madeWith: Made with the strategy helper. It is switched off until you switch it on; everything can be changed here.

interview.title: Interview in the app
interview.intro: The helper asks you a few questions, one or two at a time, about what the money is for, how you feel about risk and how you invest. When it has enough it drafts a strategy and shows it to you; nothing is saved until you say so. It uses your Anthropic API key and counts against your monthly AI budget (a talk usually costs a few cents).
interview.notReady: The AI agent is off or has no API key, so the interview cannot run. Use the free tab, or set it up in Settings, Agent.
interview.budget: You have {{left}} left of this month's AI budget.
interview.paused: This month's AI budget is used up, so the interview cannot run. Use the free tab, or raise the budget in Settings, Agent.
interview.full: This talk has reached its {{n}} answers. Save the draft below, or start a new talk.
interview.cost: This talk has cost {{spent}} so far (answer {{n}} of {{max}}). You have {{left}} left this month.
interview.draft: The helper has drafted a strategy. Read it, keep talking to change it, or save it.
